verdict.rationale: dlt directly supports local, lightweight testing via `pip install dlt[duckdb]` and running pipelines against a local DuckDB destination, with the tutorial explicitly showing loading data to DuckDB before deploying elsewhere; the destination interface abstraction lets you switch destinations without code changes, and community feedback corroborates its ease of local, code-first use. Missing for 10: no explicit hands-on test-framework/CI walkthrough distinguishing 'local test' from 'production run' beyond swapping destination config.
